findings.label: Residual grey[600] light-mode secondary text
findings.detail: Pre-existing Colors.grey[600] (#757575) is still used for light-mode secondary text in search_center_card.dart (:183), pro_upgrade_dialog.dart (:114/:152/:255), quick_start_card.dart (:92/:169), edition_version_card.dart (:117), app_info_dialog.dart (:220/:271/:500), release_notes_tab.dart (:240), and guide_tab.dart (:321). It measures 4.38:1 on lightCard (#F8F9FC) and 4.11:1 on lightBg (#F0F2F5), below the 4.5:1 AA bar for normal text, and is not covered by the verification note. It is unchanged by this commit (not a regression) and borderline, so it does not block. Follow-up: route these through GamerColors.mutedText for full light-mode consistency.
